name: alternate straight leg raise (on bosu ball)
description: A lying leg raise on a bosu ball that adds an unstable surface to challenge the lower abs and balance.
instructions: Lie back on a bosu ball with your lower back supported and your hands holding it lightly.
Brace your abs and extend both legs.
Raise one leg while keeping it straight.
Lower it and switch to the other leg.
Keep your torso steady and move with control.
